_finding: Owner, 22.11: one page with every call and its price. A price page that is wrong is worse than none: an agent that budgets 1 unit for a passport is refused a third of the way through its minute. Every price on /api is the server's own (the limiter's constants, the payment module's terms, the MCP server's tool list), and the page is read without a script, so a dead copy button must not appear there.

mutations.name: a passport is priced as a plain 1-unit read
mutations.expect: FAIL the passport costs 3 units, over HTTP and over MCP

mutations.name: a route outside the limit is priced like any other
mutations.expect: FAIL the routes outside the limit say so: the badge, /anchors/, /api/status/payments

mutations.name: the copy buttons show before the script can make them work
mutations.expect: FAIL the copy buttons are hidden until the script shows them: no dead button without it

mutations.name: what a minute buys forgets that a batch costs a tenth
mutations.expect: FAIL what a minute buys is the limiter's arithmetic

mutations.name: the case log claims more than its 7-day window
mutations.find: ask: 'The case log of the last 7 days, up to 50 events:
mutations.expect: FAIL the case log says its window: the last 7 days, up to 50 events

mutations.name: the pass card says its body is v1
mutations.find: it answers 402 with the offer, as x402 v2 in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and in the body;
mutations.replace: it answers 402 with the offer (x402 v1 in the body, v2 in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header);
mutations.expect: FAIL …and the pass card says its 402 is v2, in the header and the body, never that the body is v1
